messages:
Maya (Partnerships): Quick sync — are we agreed on embargo time (partners + press) and final asset drop deadlines? Need landing copy freeze by EOD tomorrow and SI logos + legal creds by noon PT Fri.
Devon (Marketing): agree on 9am PT embargo. Blog co-author list: me, @Alex G, @Partner PM. I’ll draft the intro today. Need hero image 1200x600 and 3 logo variations.
Alex G (Product): can we confirm marketplace listing tile will show 'Dedicated + Hosted' capability? Linking staging checklist: https://redwood.internal/docs/marketplace-staging — will review.
Priya (Legal): logo usage checklist sent to partners. Partners must sign the CLA addendum before publish. Can we have Ops hold publish until signed? I’ll escalate.
Chris (EngOps): staging slot reserved Fri 10:30 PT. Share test creds via 1Password. I’ll run a smoke test and screenshot. Quick smoke: `curl -X GET https://staging.marketplace.redwood.ai/health`
LaunchBot: DeployBot: New staging cut scheduled for 2026-05-14T10:30:00Z by @Chris
Maya (Partnerships): OK action items — Marketing hero + blog draft (Devon) by EOD tomorrow; Partners sign CA by noon Fri (Priya); EngOps smoke + screenshot by Fri 12:30 PT (Chris); Product to confirm listing tile + 3-line feature blurb (Alex). I’ll compile a single asset zip and ping here. :thumbsup:
Devon (Marketing): I’ll add localization notes — Spanish + German need separate hero crops. :eyes: Also adding short embargo FAQ for press ops.
Alex G (Product): confirmed tile copy. Feature blurb: "Deploy inference at scale — hosted, dedicated, or private with predictable SLOs." Sending final 3-line blurb in 20m. :thumbsup:
Priya (Legal): chasing legal approvals now, should have signatures from the two SI partners by EOD.
Chris (EngOps): smoke test command for engineers:
```
curl -sS -H 'Authorization: Bearer $STAGING_TOKEN' https://staging.marketplace.redwood.ai/api/v1/listings | jq '.items[] | {id,name,status}'
```
I’ll post screenshots and the health page output after run.
Maya (Partnerships): Perfect — if everyone hits deadlines we keep 9am PT embargo. If legal slips, fallback = 3pm PT same day. I’ll update execs and partner PMs.
Devon (Marketing): noted, adding press contact list and sample pitch. Will ping partners for logo variants now.
Alex G (Product): 👍
